title: Why your ads feel expensive this October

countdown.note: Diwali (Sun 8 Nov 2026). vars.days on the hook card is computed at voice time; REEL_DAYS=n overrides. Not spoken.

lines.say: Meta says its average price per ad is up twelve percent on last year.
lines.show: Meta says its average [price per ad is up 12%] on last year.

lines.say: So that's why October feels slow? Same budget, fewer sales?
lines.show: So that's why October feels [slow]? Same budget, [fewer sales]?

lines.say: Partly. Here's what's going on before Diwali.
lines.show: Partly. Here's what's going on before [Diwali].

lines.say: CPM, the price of a thousand views, climbs into Black Friday.

lines.say: No. In that same data, cost per sale fell twenty percent.

lines.say: Because conversion rate, the share who buy, rose forty-eight percent.

items.text: Ads cost more. But more people were ready to buy.

lines.say: So what do I actually fix?
Don't cut spend. Fix what happens after the click.

lines.say: Sharper offer, faster page, easier checkout. That's where money leaks.
